text:
CI-Bot: [ALERT] deploy-redwood-api: canary failure on cluster-prod-us-east-1 (job: deploy/1798123456)
Priya: paging @mike oncall — canary reports 503s and we've got error spikes in prod routing. //noticed right after the 02:15 deploy
Mike: on it. looking at the canary logs now. what was the image tag used?
CI-Bot: artifact: ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api:ci-20260315-7a9d2 (tag), digest: sha256:UNKNOWN (registry returned 404 for digest lookup)
Alex: that tag should map to digest sha256:4f3b... — CI should have pinned digests. weird.
Jamie: seeing a flurry of 502/503s from nginx ingress for the canary pods. readiness probes failing.
Mike: logs from pod canary-0: "failed to load model weights: file not found" and binary exits with code 1.
Priya: could be a bad build or registry cache poisoning — we had a flaky GHCR incident earlier this morning.
SRE-Bot: incident created: INC-2026-0315-04 (priority P1) — oncall Mike assigned.
Mike: quick mitigation: disable canary routing and divert 100% to previous stable (route rule kill-switch). Doing now.
KubeOps: executing: `kubectl -n prod patch svc inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/selector/version","value":"stable"}]'`
Alex: confirmed traffic back to stable. error rate dropped to baseline within 30s. :thumbsup:
Priya: can we roll the canary back (deployment rollback) to previous image digest while we investigate the artifact?
Mike: creating rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=23`
CI-Bot: rollback job started (job/rollback-1798123500)
Jamie: also killing feature flag for the new routing logic: `FF API: disable flag canary-auto-promote for prod`
Priya: collecting scope: which customers were affected? logs show elevated 5xx across a subset of small-tenants and all internal e2e tests hit the canary. Looks like ~2% of requests from prod for 6 minutes.
Alex: artifact registry logs: tag ci-20260315-7a9d2 was pushed at 02:10, digest lookup timed out, registry returned an old orphaned tag mapping to a partial upload => likely cache poisoning during the push window.
Mike: summary: bad push caused tag to resolve to an incomplete image (missing weights). Canary picked tag (not digest), caused crash.
Jamie: we should publish a postmortem but short term: 1) force-pull stable digest to all nodes, 2) rotate CI artifact jobs to pin digests, 3) purge GHCR tag cache if possible.
KubeOps: running force pull: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart ds/inference-cache && kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api@sha256:4f3b...`
CI-Bot: registry purge request submitted to GHCR support ticket #GHCR-7873
Priya: set task: update CI pipeline to always publish and deploy using digest. Add a linter check to fail if deployment config uses a tag instead of digest.
Mike: opened infra ticket INFRA-423: "Enforce image-by-digest in deploy manifests". Adding a canary guard to prevent tag-only rollouts.
Alex: also add automation to compare deployed image digest vs release manifest and abort if mismatch > 0.
Jamie: during the incident, we paged platform-oncall once, then re-escalated to eng-leads. Communication: customer notifications drafted by CS for impacted tenants.
Priya: we should capture timeline for the postmortem: 02:10 push, 02:15 deploy started (tag used), 02:16 canary pods crash, 02:18 oncall page, 02:20 kill-switch toggle, 02:22 rollback started, 02:25 stable traffic restored.
Mike: post-rollback checks: all pods stable on digest sha256:4f3b..., readiness green, latency normal.
KubeOps: scheduled node kubelet restart to clean any cached layers on nodes that pulled the broken image: `for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l role=prod -o name); do ssh $n 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet'; done`
CI-Bot: CI pipeline run flagged: job/build-20260315-7a9d2 -> failure to verify digest on upload step.
Priya: follow-ups: (1) CI change to publish digest and use that for deploys; (2) registry hardening & request GHCR SLAs; (3) run a dry-pull validation step in deploy pipeline that verifies image has required assets (model weights) — e.g., `docker run --rm $IMAGE ls /models || exit 1`; (4) add monitoring alert for large 5xx spike within 5m of a deploy.
Alex: I'll own (1) and (3). Mike owns INFRA-423 and the canary guard. Jamie to coordinate customer comms and postmortem write-up.
Mike: closing oncall handoff — will create a short Slack thread for the postmortem draft and link it to the incident.
Priya: thanks team. lessons learned: never deploy by floating tag during model artifact pushes.
SRE-Bot: incident INC-2026-0315-04 marked as resolved (mitigated) at 02:30.
CI-Bot: note: follow-up CI job queued for digest pin enforcement.
Alex: small TODO: add to runbook — "on canary runtime crashes check image digest first".
Jamie: sending out summary to #incidents and calendar invite for postmortem at 09:00PT. :calendar:
Mike: thanks everyone.
